title: 第3075章 姜氏界域战起二第3074章 姜氏界域战起一
content_zh:
“唰！唰！唰！”
看到敖光已经开始动手，剩下的其他真界界域归一境，也立刻全部身形一动，纷纷展露身形。
现在他们可不只是为了报仇，更是为了要在江流面前展露实力，希望得到他的青睐。
这对于他们这些真界界域种族生灵来说，方才是最为重要的事。
随着真界界域的各族生灵开始动手，一道道强大的法则之力，从他们的身上纷纷爆发出来。
“轰隆隆！”
各种法则之力，在这片虚空之中交织在一起，给姜氏界域的防御阵法，造成了极大的压力。
“结阵！”
姜尘大手一挥，朝着身后的姜家子弟下令道。
姜家子弟在整个虚空界域，都有着赫赫威名，可不单只是因为姜望的存在。
他们的战斗力，在整个虚空界域都出了名的强大。
毕竟，在姜望成为主神之前，姜家在虚空界域，就已经是最为强大种族生灵之一。
“唰！唰！唰！”
每九个姜家归一境，就组成了一个，名为九宫轮转大阵的合击阵法。
这个合击的阵法，不但可以九人攻防一体，更是可以集合九人力量化为一击。
这九人集合的一击，虽然比不上主神的战力，却可以碾压任何的一位归一境巅峰。
可以让得，哪怕在人数上面处于劣势的姜家，也可以跟真界界域的各族生灵暂时抗衡。
没错，在江流发出诏令之后，整个真界界域的归一境聚合起来之后，人数比姜家还要多。
从这里就可以不难看得出来，真界界域果然不愧是之前的第一大界域。
哪怕被彼岸血海毒害了那么久，但是，它的总体实力，却还是要比很多强大界域要更强。

也就难怪，当初姜望在姬拓陨落假死之后，会想着把彼岸血海安置在真界界域。
那是抱着，不但把彼岸血海这个包袱甩给真界界域，更是想要让真界界域就此陨落。
如果这任的混沌虚空主神，不是江流的话，估计姜望的计划，还真的会就此成功。
从此之后的每一任混沌虚空主神，也都将会受到影响。
在那之后，混沌虚空主神是所有主神里面，战力最强的主神称号，肯定也会就此不再。
而这，方才是姜望把彼岸血海，安置在真界界域的最终目的。
当然，把彼岸血海这样的凶戾空间，置放在真界界域那里，姜望肯定有不止这个目的。
而在他内心深处的更多目的，无论是江流，还是其他人，目前都无法得知。
“嗤！嗤！嗤！”
面对姜家族人的合击阵法，真界界域的各族生灵他们虽然人数众多，却并没能像姜家人一般可以凝成一股对敌。
就算那些属于十二真君的种族，也并没有像姜家一般，可以结阵进行对敌。
不是他们不想，也是在他们种族里面，没有这样的合击阵法。
而是他们的这些种族，在经过这么多年的削弱之后，竟然连组合一套合击阵法的人，都已经凑不出来。
从这里就可以看得出来，姜望当初的削弱真界界域计划，已经算得上是成功了。
content_en:
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
Seeing that Ao Guang had already started to take action, the rest of the remaining True Realm Realms also immediately moved and revealed their figures.
Now they are not just for revenge, but also to show their strength in front of Jiang Liu, hoping to win his favor.
This is the most important thing for these race creatures in the True Realm.
As the creatures of all races in the True Realm began to take action, powerful powers of law burst out from their bodies.
"Boom!"
The power of various laws are intertwined in this void, causing great pressure on the defensive formations of Jiang's realm.
"Formation!"
Jiang Chen waved his hand and gave an order to the Jiang family disciples behind him.
The children of the Jiang family are famous throughout the void realm, and not just because of Jiang Wang's existence.
Their fighting power is notoriously powerful throughout the void realm.
After all, before Jiang Wang became the main god, the Jiang family was already one of the most powerful racial creatures in the void realm.
"Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!"
Every nine Jiang families return to the same realm, forming a combined attack formation called the Nine Palaces Rotation Formation.
This combined attack formation not only allows nine people to attack and defend as one, but it can also gather nine people into one attack.
Although the attack of these nine people is not as powerful as the Lord God, it can crush any peak Guiyi Realm person.
This allows the Jiang family, even though they are at a numerical disadvantage, to temporarily contend with the creatures of all races in the True Realm.
That's right, after Jiang Liu issued the edict and the Guiyi Realm of the entire True Realm was gathered together, there were more people than the Jiang family.
From here, it is not difficult to see that the True Realm Realm is indeed the largest realm before.
Even though it has been poisoned by the blood sea on the other side for so long, its overall strength is still stronger than many powerful realms.
It's no wonder that after Jiang Wang faked his death after Ji Tuo's death, he thought of placing the other side of the blood sea in the true realm.
It was a hug, not only throwing the burden of the blood sea on the other side to the True Realm, but also wanting to make the True Realm fall.
If the current Lord God of Chaos Void was not Jiang Liu, it is estimated that Jiang Wang's plan would really succeed.
From now on, every Lord God of Chaos Void will also be affected.
After that, the title of the Lord God of Chaos Void, the most powerful Lord God among all the Lord Gods, will definitely cease to exist.
And this is Jiang Wang's ultimate goal of placing the sea of ​​blood on the other side in the true realm.
Of course, Jiang Wang must have more than this purpose in placing a ferocious space like the Blood Sea on the other side in the true realm.
And neither Jiang Liu nor anyone else can know the more purpose deep in his heart.
"Tsk! Tsk! Tsk!"
Facing the combined attack formation of the Jiang family, although there were many creatures from all races in the True Realm, they were not able to form an enemy like the Jiang family.
Even those races that belong to the Twelve True Lords are not like the Jiang family who can form formations to fight against the enemy.
It's not that they don't want to, it's also that there is no such combined attack formation in their race.
It's that these races of theirs, after so many years of weakening, can no longer even assemble a group of people to assemble a combined attack formation.
From this, it can be seen that Jiang Wang's original plan to weaken the True World Realm was considered a success.
